question: How much does spatial odor change the observed DNg100 input/margin compared with its retained distance below threshold?
exposure: Written during natural_L execution, after examining only qualification and none integrity; no L/R result inspected. Same exposed preparation, descriptive secondary analysis.
source: Final accepted RK3(2) trial of last committed epoch in each millisecond, fourth RHS at left limit of endpoint; not a new evaluation after commit.
comparison: Per DNg cell: late mean/max margin, mean net/drive/theta and mean target; source-minus-none margin at matched endpoints and its maximum absolute magnitude relative to the smallest basal below-threshold gap at those same endpoints. Ratio null if basal is not strictly below threshold.
units: Internal generic-neuron units, not mV, current, spikes or a calibrated physiological excitation requirement.
decision_scope: Characterize the separate forward-initiation problem. A large observed negative gap does not justify reducing the threshold or adding that amount of drive; no causal context mechanism identified and no new stage criterion.
budget: Included in round57 analysis300sCPU, no new CNS/GPU, no model modification. One computation plus independent check if reviewer budget permits.
